title: GitHub Actions runners will force Node.js 24 from 2026-06-02
description: actions/cache@v4, actions/checkout@v4, and softprops/action-gh-release@v2 all run on Node.js 20, which is deprecated on GitHub Actions runners from 2026-06-02. The build and release pipeline will fail on that date unless updated. Node.js 20 is removed entirely from runners on 2026-09-16.
proposed_resolution: Update all GitHub Actions workflow steps to Node.js 24-compatible action versions. Either pin updated action versions (e.g. actions/checkout@v4 with FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true on the runner, or upgrade to versions that natively support Node.js 24) or set the FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true environment variable as an interim measure. Verify all three affected actions: actions/cache, actions/checkout, softprops/action-gh-release.
